name: 789-lean-on-knee
notes: #789 B82.a beat 2 (new LeanOnKnee): a kid sits at the elder's feet facing the fire and leans the head onto the elder's knee: the body tilted 25 degrees toward it (eased in 0.8 s), a little forward, the near arm across; the elder's other hand rests on the kid's head (2.5 s) and strokes once (a slow x 20, 1 s, at 4.5 s); the look up at 7 s. Every number [est] until the user signs off the clip.
